real_apc_snapshot_proxy_check.notes: CapMetro APC provides observed stop events with vehicle_id and lat/lon, but not synchronized all-vehicle route snapshots. It is valid for external passive/few-shot APC validation and weak static local proxies; a serious local-graph claim still needs AVL/APC snapshots with neighboring vehicles/stops at the same decision time.
